It was perfectly sunny. But that yellow, it looked exactly like the life jackets we had on my uncle's boat. We used to go fishing on Lake Erie back when I was maybe ten or eleven. Caught a walleye once that was nearly as big as my arm. My uncle had this old blue Chevy truck we'd take to the marina, too... it sounded exactly like a lawnmower when it started up.
